capabilities: track time spent using Obsidian automatically
send usage activity to the WakaTime dashboard
set the WakaTime API key via a command
extras: Troubleshooting guidance points to external WakaTime documentation rather than being self-contained.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in time tracking, so users cannot see how much time they spend working in their vault.

relations.evidence: For more general troubleshooting info, see the wakatime-cli Troubleshooting Section.

summary: WakaTime integration that sends Obsidian usage activity to WakaTime for automatic time tracking and dashboard metrics.
